tools.description: Classify a piece of text into exactly one of the provided labels using the LLM proxy. The chosen label is snapped to one of the options so workflow branching is safe.

Draft a short message (email reply, post, note, summary blurb) from context in a given tone, using the LLM proxy. Returns text only — pair with a human-in-the-loop approval step before sending anything.
Extract structured fields from free text into a JSON object using the LLM proxy. Pass the field names (and optional descriptions) you want pulled out.
intentHints: pull the fields out of this email
extract the amount and due date

tools.description: Rank/prioritize a list of items against a stated criterion using the LLM proxy. Returns the items ordered most-important first, each with a score and a one-line reason.
Summarize a list of texts into a short digest using the LLM proxy.

agents.description: Fetch the user's LinkedIn feed, summarize it, and return the digest.
Triage a list of items: classify each into the given categories, prioritize by urgency/importance, and return the sorted, labeled list with the top items surfaced.

triggers.description: Fire a workflow once a day at a user-chosen time.

workflows.description: Fire once per morning; run the LinkedIn summarizer agent and write the digest.

skills.description: Classify each item into the given categories and rank by importance then urgency, with a grounded one-line reason per item, so the highest-leverage work surfaces first.
Draft a reply that matches the brand voice, leads with the answer, is concrete and safe to send (no commitments it wasn't given, no sensitive data).
Produce a faithful, grounded summary that cites its sources, separates fact from inference, preserves the source's weighting, and never invents details.
